mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the GDP growth is negative, or if the correlation between negative GDP growth and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% per month, the combined effect of high interest rates and inflationary pressure typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in the last month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decrease > 100,000 and UNRATE increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of decreasing PAYEMS and increasing UNRATE on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased construction activity boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the housing starts are increasing, or if the correlation between increasing HOUST and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% over the last two months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending declines.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between decreasing RSAFS and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
